recall_prompt: Say how you would find the 4th term from the end — how you turn it into a term from the beginning, and what the term comes to.
insider_note: Reverse the bracket first: the 4th term from the end of (2a + 5b)⁸ is the 4th term from the beginning of (5b + 2a)⁸. One line, and the from-the-end formula is never needed.

steps.label: Turn it into a term from the beginning
steps.margin_note: First mark. Reverse the bracket: the 4th term from the end of (2a + 5b)⁸ is the 4th term from the beginning of (5b + 2a)⁸.

recall.must_convey: That the 4th term from the end of (2a + 5b)⁸ is the 4th term from the beginning of (5b + 2a)⁸, which is ⁸C₃ (5b)⁵ (2a)³.
accept: reverse the bracket, the fourth from the end is the fourth from the start of five b plus two a to the eight, which is eight C three five b to the five two a cubed
the fourth term from the end is T four of the reversed binomial
write it as five b plus two a to the eight and take r equal to three
bracket reverse chesi fourth term teesukovali, eight C three five b power five two a power three
from the end means swap the two entries

steps.why: Counting from the end of (x + y)ⁿ is the same as counting from the start of (y + x)ⁿ, and terms from the start have the ready formula.
common_mistakes: Using the (n − r + 2)-th term formula and slipping in the arithmetic.
Keeping (2a + 5b) and taking r = 3, which gives the 4th term from the start.

steps.label: Evaluate

recall.must_convey: That the term is ⁸C₃·2³·5⁵·a³b⁵, which is 1400000 a³b⁵.
accept: eight C three into five to the five into two cubed a cubed b to the five, which is fourteen lakh a cubed b to the five
fifty six times three thousand one twenty five times eight a cube b power five
the term is eight C three two cube five power five a cube b power five
eight C three two power three five power five a cube b power five, fourteen lakh

steps.why: The examiner accepts the factored form; the number is a check that the factors were read correctly.
common_mistakes: Writing a⁵b³ — the power on b is 5 because b came first in the reversed bracket.
